collision_witness.required_disposition: Refuse a receiver declaration containing both; no claim of injectivity or silent salt/rehash.

locality_collision_witness.accurate_records: Complete receiving setup refuses differing canonical context values before enablement despite equal IDs
locality_collision_witness.undeclared_empty_alias_refusal: An undeclared received empty source cannot alias an explicit declared sender via receiver context substitution; runtime pre-substitution declared-sender membership refuses it through the early undeclared-source path before derivation
locality_collision_witness.false_or_stale_agreeing_records: Local comparison and raw empty-source membership do not establish remote applied setup; the same declared raw empty source under false or stale agreeing records can still pass numeric identity checks under otherwise accepting conditions

excluded_sink_pairs.outer_sink_rule: dsn~up-attributes-publish-sink~2: optional Publish sink is absent or carries a nonempty authority and wildcard type/instance/major/resource; omitted before Data-ID function entry so wildcards do not enter derivation.

dsn~up-attributes-response-sink~2: caller reply-to sink has resource 0 and no wildcards (authority may be named or empty); omitted before Data-ID function entry and does not trigger empty-authority locality agreement.

limits: Distinct boundaries: (1) valid function inputs (this record's derivation domain and rejection list); (2) whole-message admission (UAttributes sink/source validity, raw metadata/source filters and runtime pre-substitution declared-sender membership before derivation); and (3) wire corruption checks after admission. A normalized alias can still be refused by prior metadata admission; individually valid differing source/route resources remain derivable for identity discrimination, not permission to misconfigure a sending role; no protocol execution, generalized hostile-input proof or deployment collision proof.
